profile.headline: Senior Lead Platform Engineer | Building Cloud-Native Platforms at Enterprise Scale | Kubernetes • IoT • Platform Engineering
profile.summary:
I'm a platform engineering leader who enjoys solving complex infrastructure problems and building systems that quietly power great customer experiences.
Over the past 17+ years, I've worked across cloud infrastructure, Kubernetes, distributed systems, DevOps, and software engineering. Today, I lead platform engineering initiatives that support thousands of locations and tens of thousands of connected devices, partnering with engineering teams to build secure, reliable, and scalable platforms that developers enjoy using.
What motivates me most is creating leverage. Whether it's automating repetitive work, improving developer experience, or designing resilient cloud-native architectures, I enjoy building platforms that enable teams to move faster with confidence.
My areas of focus include:
• Platform Engineering
• Kubernetes & Cloud-Native Infrastructure
• Distributed Systems
• IoT Platforms
• Golang & Python
• Developer Experience (DevEx)
• Infrastructure as Code & GitOps
• Reliability, Observability, and Automation
I believe great platform engineering is about more than technology. It's about understanding the needs of developers, aligning engineering decisions with business goals, and creating systems that are both scalable and maintainable.
I'm continually learning and investing in the next stage of my career, with a particular interest in distributed systems design, platform architecture, and engineering leadership. I enjoy mentoring engineers, simplifying complex technical challenges, and sharing what I learn along the way.
If you're passionate about platform engineering, cloud-native technologies, or building reliable systems at scale, I'd love to connect.

positions.title: Senior Lead Software Engineer
positions.description: I lead the Internet of Things (IoT) Pod for Chick-Fil-A’s in restaurant kubernetes edge compute platform. My team runs MQTT and device identity services for over 50K devices at over 2700 edge locations.

positions.title: Technical Lead
positions.description:
- Leading organization wide effort to deploy Kubernetes at the edge. Including near and far edge systems.
- Implementing GitOps workflow using ArgoCD to deploy applications to multiple clusters in multiple regions. 
- Growing DevOps workflow within the organization.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Senior Software Engineer applying a diverse set of skills, including writing software, team building, and system design, to help analysts better understand and work with data.
- Developed and debugged microservices in Python to improve the reliability and extend the functionality of a system running in Kubernetes. Created documentation and training materials which were used to train and assist the support staff in the troubleshooting of the systems. Implemented and deployed monitoring technology to provide insight during outages.
- Maintained and operated a Kubernetes cluster for data analysis.
- Utilized modern web technologies to develop visual interfaces to further efforts for discovery and analysis for data scientists.  Created solutions for projects small and large.  Lead the team’s efforts to integrate unit testing best practices and continuous integration and deployment systems.
- Team Scrum Master/Certified Scrum Professional.  Led initiative to incorporate agile practices into the team. Used previous experiences to educate junior team members on agile best practices.
- Developed new components using AngularJS to streamline the user interface of a web application.  Implemented a GraphQL schema to interact with the database.  
- Led team building workshops promoting diversity and inclusion, as well as improved communication skills.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: During a long term field assignment lead the effort to migrate customers software framework to C++11 compatible compiler and a new operating system. Took over section of the framework, update dependencies, rewrote sections of code that were not C++11 compliant, and migrated the code to an automated build system.

positions.title: Co-Founder
positions.description:
Designed and developed a web application to facilitate the management of social sports teams.  Built using Ruby on Rails, Twitter Bootstrap, Twilio, and deployed using Heroku and Github
Placed 3rd in a Startup Weekend competition

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
Software developer tasked with assisting the team in developing an iOS game aimed at teaching students about being financially responsible.
Accomplishments
Implemented the triggers for character modifiers that enhanced or degraded the behavior of the users character’s in the game.
Redesigned and reimplemented several in-game screens.
